description: Look up a US address on Zillow: Zestimate, home type, beds, baths, living area, lot, tax history, listing status, nearby schools and price per square foot. Use it when: You need a US home's estimated value and key facts from its address. Not for: Homes outside the US, or the owner's identity. Returns: Zestimate, listing price and status, home type, beds, baths, living area, lot size, year built, tax history, HOA, parking and nearby schools. Typical time: about 14 s. Price: $0.006 per home, charged only on success. One call = data for one home.

address.description: Full US street address, e.g. 18 Zelma Dr, Greenville, SC 29617
